title: Perimeter and Area
seo_title: Perimeter and Area – Primary 3 Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Find the perimeter of shapes by adding the lengths of the sides; find the area of shapes by counting squares. (summary of the NERDC Primary 3 Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free Primary 3 maths worksheets on perimeter (the distance round a shape) and area (counting squares), with grids, rectangles and simple problems. 100 questions with answers.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Perimeter is the distance all the way round a shape. Add the lengths of all the sides.
  • Area is the space inside a shape. Count the squares.
  • A rectangle has two pairs of equal sides.

Examples

Example

Rectangle 5 cm by 3 cm

5 + 3 + 5 + 3

Answer: Perimeter 16 cm

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Counting squares for perimeterPerimeter is the edges, not the squares inside.
Missing a sideCount every side.
Forgetting the unitsPerimeter is in cm or m.
